payload.text: ISSUE:0301 (cc, after WP02a, vc 2026-10-31): the release fixtures' builders return their failures: every step of git_project and cut_project, each builder calling git_project || return 1; releasestatus.bats:339's second released_project clears the first's demo and remote.git, as :670 does; the gh stub's create and edit writes exit 1 when they fail. Its run: every git_project caller's file under BSD, releasestatus and releasecut under GNU, the tree scans and help.
